symptom: `case $Item/"Color" when … end case` stored the split expression `$Item/"Color"` with the quotes; mx check failed CE0117 "Error(s) in expression" at the decision. The same quoted member in an if, set, change or return was stripped.
cause: The case source took attr.GetText(), the raw token text, where SET already rebuilt the path from its structured segments with quotes stripped (attributePathTargetText).
fix: buildCaseStatement uses attributePathTargetText for an attribute-path source.
insight: Every `ctx.GetText()` on a path or name is a quote-stripping bug waiting for a quoted identifier; the skills tell users to quote everything, so the quoted form is the common one. grep GetText() next to AttributePath() when one of these turns up.
test: mdl/visitor/case_quoted_source_2605_test.go (quoted member, unquoted control, quoted association path); failed before the fix. Live 11.12.6: stored split $Item/Color, describe prints it unquoted, mx check 0 errors.
